nodes.label: ADR-002: Story-First Memory Architecture
nodes.rationale: Flat chronological logs and raw-chunk vector similarity leave the companion blind to the larger journeys a user is navigating, producing fragmented feedback. Status: Accepted.

nodes.label: Story (narrative grouping anchor)
nodes.rationale: Humans organize experience as narratives, not timelines. Stories are poly-hierarchical so one memory node can belong to several journeys at once, and recalling one memory raises retrieval probability of related milestones in the same arc. Memories in completed stories are preserved as high-importance experiential context instead of decaying out.
